text:
Ana (infra): Bringing up the new SJC GPU cluster egress today. Plan: TGW peering -> AZ routed attachments, 2 NAT gateways (one per AZ) for now, private hosted zone delegation for svc.internal.redwood. Need EIP quota check + validation steps. Who's available for a quick handoff after smoke tests?
Sam J: I can take the EIP quota request. Filing AWS quota ticket now for +20 Elastic IPs for account:sjc-prod. Also checking existing NAT GW count per AZ.
ops-bot: :information_source: Quota request INC-3421 created for Elastic IPs (+20). ETA 4-6 hrs.
Liam K: Quick cost note: NAT Gateway is simpler and autoscale-friendly but egress bytes cost adds up. If we expect <1TB/mo in early days fine. For bursty pps we might need proxied NLB -> NAT instances later.
Maria S: Agree. Also can we use TGW centralized egress (single NAT cluster) to avoid per-VPC EIP overhead? Tradeoffs: single egress path simpler ops, cross-AZ data charges.
Ana (infra): Decision: start with TGW + per-AZ NAT GW for redundancy. Centralized egress left as phase 2 if costs spike. Need these validations: route propagation, route tables priority, security group egress, resolv.conf for private zone, and BFD/bgp health on TGW attachment.
Chao: Running pre-checks now. Quick commands I'll run: ```
# validate NAT allocation
aws ec2 describe-addresses --filters Name=domain,Values=vpc
# check TGW attachments
aws ec2 describe-transit-gateway-attachments --filters Name=resource-type,Values=vpc
```
Sam J: Post here once you have allocation IDs. My ticket returned a temporary limit increase for 24h while AWS approves permanent. Keep a note: allocate-address returns allocationId eipalloc-0a1b2c3d.
Maria S: DNS steps: create private hosted zone svc.internal.redwood, associate with vpc-0abcd1234 (SJC-prod). Also create delegation from parent zone (internal.redwood) with the 4 name servers returned by the private zone. Remember to add glue if parent is in a different account.
Ana (infra): Runbook validation checklist (quick):
1) Allocate EIPs in each AZ.
2) Create NAT GW per subnet: ```aws ec2 create-nat-gateway --subnet-id subnet-aaa --allocation-id eipalloc-0a1b2c3d```
3) Attach NAT GW to route table for private subnets (0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-xxxxxxxx).
4) Create TGW attachment + route propagate for VPC route tables.
5) Validate outbound from worker nodes: `curl -sS https://ifconfig.co/json` -> should reflect EIP.
6) DNS: associate private hosted zone, test `dig svc.svc.internal.redwood @<VPC-DNS-IP> +short`.
Chao: Doing step 5 now from each AZ worker pool: AZ-a -> returns eipalloc-0a1b2c3d, AZ-b -> returns eipalloc-0b2c3d4e. Traceroute shows TGW hop then NAT GW.
deploy-bot: Smoke tests: egress check passed (3/3 subnets). Sample output:
```
[AZ-a] curl https://httpbin.org/status/200 -> 200
[AZ-b] curl https://httpbin.org/get -> 200
[AZ-c] curl https://ifconfig.co/ip -> "54.182.11.22"
```
Sam J: Note: we hit account EIP soft limit in us-west-2 in the past. If any other teams in SJC allocate, request might stall. I've added alert to paging policy if EIP allocation error occurs.
Maria S: After NATs are up, I pushed the private hosted zone association. Test: `dig +short host.svc.internal.redwood` returns internal IP. Also ensure VPC DNS setting "enableDnsHostnames" and "enableDnsSupport" are true.
Ana (infra): Found one issue: one private route table still had 0.0.0.0/0 -> local instead of nat. Fixed. Re-running smoke.
Chao: Verified outbound HTTP/HTTPS, DNS resolution and reverse-proxy checks. Also checked security group egress: 0.0.0.0/0 allowed on worker SG for ephemeral egress ports.
Liam K: Ops note for handoff doc: include cost estimate snippet and a toggle to flip to centralized egress. Add billing alert: sample CloudWatch alarm for NAT DataProcessed > 500 GB / month.
Ana (infra): Handoff checklist complete: runbook updated https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/infra/pages/SJC+Egress+Runbook, TGW attachments tagged with team:infra, quota ticket INC-3421 linked, and alerts created.
Sam J: I'll follow up with account team to get permanent EIP quota increase.
Maria S: I'll take ownership of DNS delegation post-handoff.
Ana (infra): Great work team. Marking this thread resolved for handoff. Please ping if you see any NAT allocation failures or DNS propagation issues. :white_check_mark:
